label: Grainient
desc: A slow gradient of drifting brand-colour fields with film grain over it; pure CSS, so it costs almost nothing.
use: Behind a landing hero, pricing band or sign-in panel (first child of a position:relative section; fills its parent).

label: Grid distortion
desc: A line grid that bends away from the pointer and springs back; taps send ripples through it and a slow swell keeps it alive when idle.
use: Behind a hero or feature section where the page should feel responsive to the cursor (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Grid motion
desc: A tilted wall of tiles whose rows slide in alternating directions; a slow marquee runs by itself and the pointer shoves the rows sideways.
use: Behind a hero or a product-gallery teaser (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Grid scan
desc: A measuring grid with crosshair marks that a slanted scan line sweeps across, lighting cells that fade out behind it; the pointer lights nearby cells.
use: Behind a technical or security hero, a dashboard empty state or a loading screen (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Hyperspeed
desc: A star-warp of streaks flying out of a vanishing point; the pointer steers it and press-and-hold boosts to hyperspeed.
use: Behind a launch hero, a call to action or a 'getting started' step (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Iridescence
desc: An oil-slick thin-film surface drawn by a fragment shader, pulled toward the brand colours, with a soft sheen; the pointer presses a dent into it.
use: Behind a hero, a card or a feature banner (first child of a position:relative section; static CSS gradient without WebGL).

label: Letter glitch
desc: A field of monospace characters that keep flipping to new glyphs and blending between ink and brand colours, with occasional row tears.
use: Behind a developer-tool hero, a 404 page or an error state (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Lightfall
desc: Comet streaks of light fall in three depths, land on a glowing horizon and ripple out; the pointer leans the fall sideways.
use: Behind a hero, a footer call to action or a quiet content break (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Lightning
desc: Branching lightning bolts strike by themselves, flicker and flash the sky; click or tap calls a strike at that point.
use: Behind a high-energy hero, an outage page or a 'power' feature block (first child of a position:relative section).

label: Light pillar
desc: Vertical beams of light rise from a glowing floor with a hot core, slow shimmer and drifting embers; the pillar nearest the pointer swells.
use: Behind a hero, an award or launch announcement, or a pricing highlight (first child of a position:relative section).
